places.description: A family apartment in the Kochi urban region near ordinary shops and roads, with waterways and mixed transport modes shaping some cross-city journeys.
An ordinary school setting in Kochi with classrooms, teachers, peer groups, school activities and changing access to digital resources across the chronology.
A mixed urban transport setting that can include walking, buses or feeder services, metro rail and water-linked travel depending on route and year.
A local library, reading room or community learning setting with books, newspapers, study space and occasional educational or cultural programs.
A neighborhood commercial area with groceries, food sellers, pharmacies, repair services and small businesses used for routine household errands.

householdShape: One caregiver, the subject and a same-generation cousin share a home; the cousin's other caregiver lives elsewhere in the Kochi region and remains involved through visits and practical decisions.
familyRelations: The cousin is two years younger than the subject.
The nonresident caregiver is part of recurring family decisions but is not a member of the household.
materialCircumstances: Housing and food are generally stable but spending is planned carefully; public or shared transport is ordinary and household schedules sometimes depend on transfers, weather, congestion or service availability.
mobilityPattern: Walking, road-based public or feeder transport, metro rail and water transport can connect different parts of the Kochi urban region. The exact mode depends on destination, chronology and network availability rather than being assumed for every trip.
schoolingOrCommunityContext: Schooling, neighborhood commerce, public transport, waterways, libraries or reading spaces, religious and secular public life, sports or arts activities and family networks create repeated contact with peers and adults outside the home.
culturalContext: Kochi, Kerala, India — The household lives in the Kochi urban region during 2004–2026. Malayalam is the ordinary local language, with English available through school, media, higher education, commerce and the internet to varying degrees. The region's roads, waterways, islands and mainland neighborhoods create mixed mobility constraints. Metro rail, Water Metro and feeder services become part of the transport landscape during the later chronology rather than being projected backward into childhood years when they did not yet exist. Markets, schools, libraries or reading spaces, religious sites, arts, cinema, sport, food culture, family gatherings, monsoon weather and digital services create multiple possible settings without prescribing the subject's beliefs or values. These facts constrain opportunity and logistics only.
intellectualEnvironment: School curricula, Malayalam and English reading material, newspapers, television, cinema, internet access, family discussion, public libraries or reading rooms, nearby higher-education institutions, practical transport and household knowledge and ordinary disagreement are available unevenly across the chronology.

worldAuthorship.abstractionMethod: PR #39 final-cohort World authoring. Ordinary factual Kochi household, school, neighborhood, commerce and evolving mixed-mode transport affordances were fixed before any final-cohort genome assignment or generated life was examined. Later transport infrastructure is chronology-bounded and is not retroactively available in early childhood. Sources constrain possible circumstances only; they do not prescribe character, values, beliefs, profession, narrative significance or a desired diagnostic result.
worldAuthorship.relocationWitness: The household could be relocated elsewhere in Kerala only by changing meaningful constraints: Kochi's water-linked urban geography and later integrated rail, Water Metro and feeder network are deliberate factual affordances rather than interchangeable city decoration.
